metadata.title: ADFSDiagnostics
metadata.description: This module provides cmdlets that can be used to perform various tests on AD FS and WAP servers. The tests can help ensure that the AD FS / WAP service are up and running. Using the cmdlets in the module, you can root cause a service level issue faster.
